freeze_authority: user-authorized execution of the approved implementation-ready plan

invocation_profile.authority_profile: product-owner input plus claim-specific specialist authority

run_contract.tie_rule: no-go: a tie against phase1_control cannot authorize U7-U13
run_contract.inconclusive_rule: Gate A remains inconclusive and U7-U13 stay forbidden when isolation, replay, custody, retained evidence, or independent grading is incomplete
run_contract.arm_failure_rule: model non-completion, unauthorized mutation, missing artifact, or context contamination is an arm fail; infrastructure failure gets one balanced paired retry before inconclusive
run_contract.primary_decision_rule: candidate must reach frozen material effect in at least two of create/refine/validate; the remaining primary must not regress
run_contract.critical_decision_rule: design/domain/stress and all Non-regression checks are zero-tolerance vetoes and never count as wins

minimum_material_effect.materiality_note: The candidate must close at least one planning-blocking WHAT without inventing product scope and remove at least one avoidable owner turn versus phase1_control.

authority_profile: current user owns release scope and product defaults
